summary: Island-side kerb of a leafy cul-de-sac bulb, nearly flat at the far end.
reasons: Backs onto planted island and bush
Nearest home 24 m at far end

drivers.access_and_room: Sealed turning bulb wide enough to pull off the through line.

Cul-de-sac turning area; a van could block residents
sun_shade: Dense tree cover over the island and the section, mainly from the south-west.
